Name: Multi-Domain Battle Management Interface
Problem statement: Challenge: Create an intuitive commander's dashboard that processes multi-domain data and provides actionable insights within 3 seconds. Process simulated feeds from air, land, and naval assets. Prioritize threats using AI. Generate course-of-action recommendations.

Name: GPS-Denied Swarm Coordination
Problem statement: Challenge: Develop a distributed algorithm for UAV swarm navigation without GPS. Coordinate 5+ UAVs simultaneously. Maintain formation in a simulated urban environment. Avoid collisions and obstacles. Operate with local communication only.

Name: Real-Time Sensor Fusion
Problem statement: Challenge: Create a system that combines data from radar, infrared, and optical sensors to identify and track targets. Filter false positives. Track multiple targets simultaneously. Generate confidence scores for detections.

Name: Edge Computing Object Detection
Problem statement: Challenge: Develop a lightweight ML model for object detection optimized for mobile devices. Run on low-power hardware at 15+ FPS. Identify 10 types of military vehicles. Operate for 8+ hours on battery.

Name: Autonomous Underwater Navigation
Problem statement: Challenge: Develop innovative approaches for truly autonomous underwater navigation that allows precise delivery of payloads to destination points without surfacing for GNSS. Communication is secondary; the primary goal is reliable underwater navigation.

Name: Counter-Airborne Threats to USVs
Problem statement: Challenge: Design systems to detect, track, and respond to air targets threatening kamikaze USVs. Ensure mission success in contested environments against helicopters and low-flying aircraft.

Name: Radio Mesh Range Extension
Problem statement: Challenge: Strategically position radio relays in 2D or 3D to extend radio mesh range for drone group operations in GPS-denied environments.

Name: Optical Target Re-Identification
Problem statement: Challenge: After a tracked object exits the camera frame, re-detect and re-identify it preserving the same ID when it reappears. Enable multiple drones to recognize they are tracking the same object.
